:::{#thm-lasso-soft-threshold}
#### The LASSO with one predictor soft-thresholds

Consider a Gaussian linear model with no intercept,
one predictor $x$ scaled so that $\sumin x_i^2 = 1$,
and error variance $\sigma^2 = 1$,
so that the log-likelihood is
$\llik(\beta) = c - \frac{1}{2} \sumin (y_i - x_i \beta)^2$
for a constant $c$ that does not depend on $\beta$.
Let $z \eqdef \sumin x_i y_i$,
the [ordinary least squares](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/correlation-regression.html#def-ols) estimate of $\beta$ in this model.
Then the LASSO estimate (@def-lasso) is

$$
\est{\beta}_\lambda =
\begin{cases}
z - \lambda & \text{if } z > \lambda \\
0 & \text{if } \abs{z} \le \lambda \\
z + \lambda & \text{if } z < -\lambda
\end{cases}
$$ {#eq-lasso-soft-threshold}

:::
